note: LEADS.md HotRod (sangharshadhyeta/Strata-HotRod) substitute fit: per-pair ridge / low-rank corrections of stand-in expert outputs. Base = the HotRod stand-ins as spec 95's route-budget and standin-recheck arms set them (STRATA_ROUTE_RESIDENT=1 margin, STRATA_ROUTE_BUDGET=0.5, STRATA_FRAGILE_RECHECK=1: the re-check gives the shadow samples and the held rows flip needs). subfit-learn: the live learner, observe only (same picks and weights; its cost). dynamic: a fitted move past its bound (budget or margin) is taken corrected instead of refused. all: every fitted move corrected. flip: fitted moves corrected in the re-check's held row only. The learner keeps its state in subfit-learn-<fp>.bin beside the expert profile across runs: delete it before the run for a cold start, or run the subfit-learn arm first to warm it. Speed screen; a promoted arm needs a quality gate (lossy). Stop pancake.service first.
